# SubmenuPlacement

`Flare.Components.SubmenuPlacement`

Placement of the submenu relative to the parent item.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `End` | `0` | Submenu opens to the right of the parent item. |
| `Start` | `1` | Submenu opens to the left of the parent item. |
| `Bottom` | `2` | Submenu opens below the parent item. |
| `Top` | `3` | Submenu opens above the parent item. |

## Used by components

- `FlareSubMenu`
